title: 第十三章阴差阳错第十四章 突破三玄境苏阳下山
content_zh:
“哼，有何事情，要如此慌张？又不是天塌下来了。”只见一位王府小厮，此刻正着急忙慌的跑进大厅。本就有客人在，王朗见状，神情自然颇为难看。
不过也很快反应过来道：“刀总管？怎么回事？他不是带着几位高手去妖兽山脉了吗？”
“家..家主，属下也不知道怎么回事啊。刀总管现在就在门外，已经无法动弹，气若游丝了....”王府小厮低着头，浑身颤栗道。
王朗闻言，不由眉头一锁。
随即便对着望月宗的长老笑道：“毕长老，还请您先去休息，晚上本家主再为您接风洗尘，如今有家事要处理，还请见谅。”
“王家主客气了，既然贵府有事，老朽也不打扰了。”望月宗长老微微一笑道。
“依依，你先带毕长老去休息。”
“好的。”
说罢，王朗便脸色难看的走出了大厅之内。
还没等王朗走到王府门外，周围百姓的议论之声便传入了王朗耳中。
“啧啧，这不是王府的刀总管吗？怎么变成了这般模样....”
“谁知道呢，看这样子怕是活不久了吧。”
“刀总管可是三玄境圆满的高手，在这叶北城里也是响当当的人物，会是谁能把他伤成这般模样？”
“....鬼知道呢，能在这个节骨眼上惹王府，怕不是一般人吧？”
“.....”
王朗闻言，脸色更为难看了。
此刻他在想，是不是自己的属下，遇见了那头伤人的妖兽，不敌....所以才大败而归？根本没考虑到，会是叶北城其余势力之人出的手。
当王朗走出门外，看见躺着地上奄奄一息的刀总管时，脸色神情简直阴冷的可怕。
作为神武境高手的他，一眼就能看出，刀总管的伤势明显不是妖兽所为，妖兽与人类不同，但凡出手，都会留下痕迹，哪怕是妖兽的气息。
而刀总管身上一点妖兽的气息都没有，反而...还有一股令他都感觉心悸的战意....

“快将其抬进府中。”王朗说罢，甩手离去。
身边的仆人也都开始行动起来，先前迎宾的小厮也很明事理道：“诸位乡情父老，承蒙诸位前来祝贺，还请大家散去，日后我王府定会感谢。”
说完，也不顾百姓的反应如何，便关上了大门。
很快，刀总管便被抬进了一间单房里面。
只有王朗待在屋中，看着自己的属下，体内灵气运转，接连点了刀总管身上的几个穴位，又拿出一粒丹药喂入他的口中。
原本昏迷不醒的刀总管，在此刻却缓缓睁开了眼睛。
王朗见状，急忙问道：“是何人将你伤成这般模样？”
虽然刚才王朗续了一口刀总管的命，可此时刀总管体内的五脏六腑，奇经八脉都被苏阳的强大力量所震碎。即便是王朗，也无力回天！
刀总管瞪着一双恐惧的双眸，张合着嘴巴，发出十分轻微的声音。
王朗见状，急忙将右耳凑近聆听。
content_en:
"Hmph, what's the matter, why are you so panicked? It's not like the sky is falling." I saw a servant from the palace running into the hall in a hurry. There were already guests there, so when Wang Lang saw this, his expression was naturally quite ugly.
But he quickly reacted and said: "Manager Sword? What's going on? Didn't he take a few masters to the Monster Mountain Range?"
"Family...Master, my subordinates don't know what's going on. Chief Dao is right outside the door. He can't move anymore and is out of breath..." The servant in the palace lowered his head and trembled all over.
Wang Lang couldn't help but frown when he heard this.
Then he smiled at the elder of Wangyue Sect and said: "Elder Bi, please go and rest first. The master of the family will take care of you in the evening. I have family matters to deal with now. Please forgive me."
"Master Wang, you're welcome. Since there is something going on in your house, I won't bother you anymore." The elder of Wangyue Sect said with a slight smile.
"Yiyi, take Elder Bi to rest first."
"Okay."
After saying that, Wang Lang walked out of the hall with an ugly expression.
Before Wang Lang could reach the gate of the palace, the voices of the people around him reached Wang Lang's ears.
"Tsk, tsk, isn't this the chief swordsman of the palace? How did it become like this..."
"Who knows, I'm afraid he won't live long if he looks like this."
"The Sword Master is a perfect master of the Three Mysteries Realm, and he is also a well-known figure in Yebei City. Who could hurt him like this?"
"....Who knows, if you can provoke the prince at this juncture, you're probably not an ordinary person, right?"
"..."
When Wang Lang heard this, his expression became even more ugly.
At this moment, he was wondering whether his subordinates met that hurtful monster and were defeated... so they returned defeated? He never thought that people from other forces in Ye Beicheng would take action.
When Wang Lang walked out of the door and saw the dying Manager Dao lying on the ground, his expression was extremely cold and terrifying.
As a master of the Divine Martial Realm, he could tell at a glance that the Sword Master's injuries were obviously not caused by monsters. Monsters are different from humans. Whenever they attack, they will leave traces, even if it is the breath of monsters.
The sword manager didn't have any aura of monsters on his body, but... there was a fighting spirit that made his heart palpitate...
"Bring him into the house quickly." Wang Lang said and left.
The servants around him also started to take action, and the young man who had previously welcomed the guests also said very sensibly: "Dear fellow nostalgic elders, thank you for coming to congratulate me, and please disperse. My palace will definitely thank you in the future."
After saying that, he closed the door regardless of the people's reaction.
Soon, Chief Dao was carried into a single room.
Only Wang Lang stayed in the room, watching his subordinates, with spiritual energy circulating in his body. He tapped several acupuncture points on the Sword Master's body, and took out a pill and fed it into his mouth.
The knife manager, who was originally unconscious, slowly opened his eyes at this moment.
Wang Lang saw this and asked hurriedly: "Who hurt you like this?"
Although Wang Lang had just saved the life of the Sword Master, all the internal organs, special meridians and eight meridians in the Sword Master's body were shattered by Su Yang's powerful power. Even Wang Lang can't save him!
The sword manager stared with a pair of fearful eyes, opened and closed his mouth, and made a very slight sound.
Seeing this, Wang Lang quickly put his right ear close to listen.
